page.notes: Transcription is of the printed text; the Greek word δυνάμεις is printed as δυνάμεις-like Greek with accent. Marked uncertain: "misso" (printed "misso" with a long s form, read as missō), and "suffiaminato" should read "suffflaminato" (printed flaminato with ligature). Marginal fragment marks in the margins are not printed text.
